answer: Hardware-rooted admission binds each agent to a TPM endorsement key burned in at the factory. The chip signs a quote of the booted kernel plus the agent's Falcon public key, and one chip earns one seat. Virtual machines have nothing to sign with, so a farm buys a board per head. A certificate thread traces every chip to its production lot, and seats per lot are capped, so each extra fake needs scarcer boards from new lots.
